In 2021, Sézane became B-corp certified. This stringent, independent label attests to the concrete results of our team in meeting the strictest social and environmental standards. Every month, we propose two philanthropic drives:
Pink Wednesday: On the first Wednesday of every month, we support international organizations involved with breast cancer research, treatment, and awareness. The Call of the 21st: On the 21st of every month, 10% of the day’s gross sales revenue and 100% of the net profits of sales from a dedicated solidarity piece are donated to our partner organizations all around the world.
